'''Suturer''' is the skill associated with the [[Suturing]] [[labor]]. Suturers are responsible for closing wounds using [[thread|thread]] at a [[hospital]]. Additionally, in the latest version, dwarves who discuss or ponder the [[topic]] "Suturing" as scholars will gain points in this skill.

Suturer [[skill|skill level]] is related to the speed at which the labor is completed and rate of [[healthcare#Infection|infection]]{{verify}}. The longer that the wound is open, the more likely bleeding out and infection become. The quality, type or dye of the thread is not related to outcome - suturers will even use [[adamantine]] strands for this purpose. Severed limbs are beyond your suturers' abilities, even at Legendary+5.

Suturers put your fortress' injured back together as part of the [[health care|health care industry]].  The suturer skill is also used by [[scholars]] when thinking about medical science-related [[topics]]:

{{DF2014:Topic/table/medicine}}
